items.title: Japanese borrowing costs hit 30-year high as Bessent says Tokyo may intervene to boost yen
items.description: The yen weakened to 160 per dollar on Tuesday as bond yields came under pressure, as traders eyed the potential for Japan to hike interest rates.

items.title: Tehran urges return to June deal, oil prices rise as Trump vows to hit Iran 'hard'
items.description: Iran launched an attack on two American bases in Jordan on Monday in retaliation for the U.S. attack on its Larak Island.

items.title: Qualcomm rival MediaTek jumps 10% after $3.5 billion Nvidia AI chip deal
items.description: The two companies will work on integrating Nvidia technology with MediaTek's custom AI chip business as well as other areas such as PCs and cars.

items.title: Hugging Face's new duck robot is selling fast. A Chinese chip powers it
items.description: The colorful "Microduck" robot from HuggingFace's French subsidiary Pollen Robotics has sold more than 10,000 units since launching on Thursday.

items.title: Indian Prime Minister Modi asks Putin to end Ukraine war amid U.S. tariff threat on Russian oil
items.description: Indian PM Narendra Modi has urged Russia to end the Ukraine war and to cease hostilities.

items.title: Supreme Court lets Trump build White House ballroom as lawsuit continues
items.description: Chief Justice John Roberts dissented with three liberal justices, saying, "That construction is likely unlawful."

items.title: These emerging markets are favored to get 'a wall of money' from carry trades
items.description: Emerging markets could attract more capital as Treasury bond buyback plans weaken the dollar and support carry trades, analysts say.

items.title: Fast-fashion giant Shein's shares drop 9% in Hong Kong market debut
items.description: Shein made its Hong Kong market debut on Tuesday after years of attempts to go public.

items.title: Bessent reportedly tells Russia no economic relief until Ukraine war ends as Europe snubs Moscow at G20
items.description: The meeting underscored Washington's willingness to reopen diplomatic talks with Moscow, as Europe intends to isolate the nation while the war continues.

items.title: Venezuela grants U.S.-backed oil firm NABEP 100-year concessions for 17 oil fields, White House says
items.description: Venezuelan interim authorities have granted North American Blue Energy Partners 100-year concessions for 17 oil fields, White House says.

items.title: The $3 trillion oil market has just gotten more accessible than ever: No longer a 'rich man's game'
items.description: Oil trading is becoming more accessible to individual investors as smaller futures contracts, ETFs and online brokerages lower longtime barriers to the market.

items.title: August was the month of the comeback kids. Cramer reviews what drove the biggest winners
items.description: CNBC's Jim Cramer said August was a comeback month for stocks that had been battered by bearish narratives.

items.title: CNBC's The China Connection newsletter: McKinsey's contrarian economic view
items.description: In many ways it seems that the party has ended for many U.S. and European corporations that once enjoyed a big advantage in China.

items.title: Microsoft Outlook and OpenAI's ChatGPT Work are experiencing user outages
items.description: OpenAI's ChatGPT Work offering was down for some users on Monday, and Microsoft said it was having issues with Exchange Online.

items.title: House Intelligence Committee warns of 'Black Swan' AI risks
items.description: Bipartisan lawmakers cautioned that existing safeguards may not be enough to keep up with AI's advances.

items.title: Trump Account holders may receive $250 Dell grant starting Monday, Dell Foundation says
items.description: Eligible children with Trump Accounts will start receiving the $250 Dell gift this week, according to the Dell Foundation.

items.title: Bessent pushes back on Druckenmiller critique of bond intervention
items.description: Bessent, at a G20 finance meeting, told CNBC he spoke with Stanley Druckenmiller after his critical op-ed was published and that their conversation went "fine."

items.title: Trump says U.S. growth could hit 20%. It’s happened only once since WWII
items.description: Trump argued rapid growth should not prompt Fed rate hikes, even as inflation remains above the central bank’s 2% target.

items.title: FTC sues Amazon, accusing the e-commerce giant of misleading advertisers
items.description: The FTC sued Amazon, alleging the company misled advertisers through a deceptive auctioning system.

items.title: Trump strikes new drug pricing deals with nine midsized drugmakers
items.description: The string of deals builds on the Trump administration's push to link the nation's drug prices to cheaper ones abroad.
